$comment: Interface texts in English. Same keys and placeholders as ru.json.
language.name: English
banner.demo: DEMO · practice data, rules not approved.
home.title: Your preparation plan
home.scope: Only two procedures are covered. Arrange migration registration separately with your university. Marks are self-reported, not an official decision.
home.reminders.off: Reminders: off. Turn them on — the bot will write 7, 3 and 1 day before each date at 09:00 Moscow time and once the day after it.
card.overdue: The calculated date has passed. You still need to complete the procedure — do not put it off. The bot does not assess the consequences: ask {uni} what to do — a ready question is behind the button below.
calendar.intro: Your dates as a file: open it to add the events to your phone calendar. The calendar will remind you 7, 3 and 1 day before at 09:00 Moscow time, even with bot notifications off. These are calculated dates, not an official decision. After changing your marks, export again: events update instead of duplicating.
help.generic.draft: I study at {uni} and need help with __. My obstacle is __. Please explain the next step and required documents.
help.draft: Hello! I am an international {uni} student ({who}). I need to complete “{title}”, calculated deadline {due}. The problem: ___. Could you tell me the next step and the documents I need?
help.draft.overdue: Hello! I am an international {uni} student ({who}). I need to complete “{title}”; the calculated deadline was {due} and has passed. The reason: ___. Could you tell me how to complete it now and which documents I need?
help.intro: What is in the way: a missing document, no booking, or an unclear next step? Here is a ready question for {uni}: copy it, replace ___ with your obstacle and send it yourself:
help.intro.overdue: The calculated date has passed. Do not put it off: tell {uni} and ask how to complete the procedure now. The bot does not assess the consequences and is not legal advice. A ready question: copy it, replace ___ with the reason and send it yourself:
consent: The bot stores your MAX ID, language, dates and checkmarks in its database until deletion or 400 days of inactivity. To measure usefulness it only counts daily totals of actions, without your MAX ID. Do not send passports or medical files. /delete removes your profile and queued jobs; event fingerprints expire within 7 days. This is preparation support, not legal advice. Continue?
scope: Scope: age 18+, first entry for study longer than 90 days, {uni} dormitory, no residence permit and no previously completed procedures. Entry from 2026-09-01. Does everything match? In demo, answer for a fictional student.
entry.invalid: Invalid or unsupported date. Enter YYYY-MM-DD from 2026-09-01 through today; /help for support.
completion: Enter the actual completion date YYYY-MM-DD or /today. This is self-reported, not confirmation from the authorities.
completion.invalid: Use a date between entry and today, later than the previous completion. /plan to cancel.
delete: Delete your profile, checkmarks and all pending messages?
deleted: Your data and pending messages were deleted. /start to begin again.
rulesChanged: Rules changed. Calculations are paused. Use /delete and start again.
reminder.overdue: Reminder: {title} — the calculated deadline was {due}. You still need to complete it: the card shows what to do and a ready question for your university.
ics.name: First 90 days
ics.calculated: Calculated date, not an official decision.
ics.provisional: The rule has not been legally reviewed yet.
